documents.text:
Annual report extract: Castellan Software (fictional, authored test material).
Castellan Software had gross debt of $292.8m in FY2025 (reported basis). For Castellan Software, free cash flow in H1 2025 was $23.8m (reported basis). Senior leverage at Castellan Software stood at 2.46x in FY2025. Castellan Software had receivables in arrears of 5.1% in FY2024, as originally reported.

Quarterly lender update: Castellan Software (fictional, authored test material).
Castellan Software had gross debt of USD 292.8 million in FY2025 (reported basis). For Castellan Software, free cash flow in FY2025 was $49.1m (reported basis). Cash on balance sheet at Castellan Software stood at $10.1m in FY2024 (reported basis), first issue. Castellan Nordic, a subsidiary had debt service cover ratio of 1.07x in FY2025.

documents.title: Independent business review
documents.text:
Independent business review: Castellan Software (fictional, authored test material).
Castellan Software had senior leverage of 3.08x in FY2023. For Castellan Software, receivables in arrears in FY2024 was 3.7%, as restated in the latest accounts. Cash on balance sheet at Castellan Software stood at $8.2m in FY2024 (reported basis), second issue (corrects the first issue). Castellan Software had debt service cover ratio of 1.42x in FY2025.
